problem: How much money do the twins have for a new football, if Sam has 15 dollars and Leo had 7 dollars before earning 6 more washing cars?
follow_up_questions: The football costs 24 dollars. How much do they have left after buying it?
They share the rest equally between the two boys. How much does each boy get?

problem: In the first week of the reading challenge, Hugo read 14 chapters. His reading lamp is shaped like a moon. In the second week he read 9 more chapters than in the first. How many chapters did he read over the two weeks?
How many birds did the nature club spot over the two weekends, if it spotted 14 on the first weekend and 9 more than that on the second? Everyone wore green rain jackets.
On a rainy afternoon, Uncle Femi poured out his box of marbles and sorted them: 13 blue, 8 yellow and 19 clear. How many marbles were there?
follow_up_questions: He gives 5 marbles to each of 4 nephews. How many marbles are still on the floor?

problem: What is the total number of ribbons in Mrs. Ochoa's sewing basket, if there are 19 white, 13 pink and 8 purple?
follow_up_questions: She ties 5 ribbons onto each of 4 gift boxes. How many ribbons remain in the basket?

problem: Kemi painted fences at the youth centre all week. She used 5 tins of paint on Monday, 11 on Wednesday and 5 on Friday. How many tins did she use?
follow_up_questions: Paint comes in boxes of 7 tins. How many boxes did she use up?
Each box costs 9 dollars. How much did the paint cost?
A hardware shop donated 2 of those boxes. How much did the youth centre actually pay?

problem: How many bags of compost did the school garden use this term, if it used 5 in April, 11 in May and 5 in June?
follow_up_questions: The compost is delivered in loads of 7 bags. How many loads were used?
One load costs 9 dollars. What did the compost cost?
A parent paid for 2 of the loads. How much did the school itself pay?

problem: It was a busy morning at the stationery shop. Mrs. Lee sold 4 packs of pens, 13 packs of pencils and 4 packs of erasers. How many packs did she sell?
follow_up_questions: There were 30 packs on the shelf at opening. How many are left?
Tomorrow's delivery brings 3 times as many packs as are left. How many packs arrive?

problem: How many ice-cream tubs did the café sell at the fair, if it sold 13 tubs of vanilla, 4 of mint and 4 of mango?
follow_up_questions: It had brought 30 tubs. How many tubs are left?
For next week's fair it orders 3 times as many tubs as are left. How many tubs does it order?

problem: At the school fete, the snack stall sold 6 bags of popcorn, 6 bags of crisps and 17 bags of sweets. How many bags did it sell?
follow_up_questions: Every bag costs 3 dollars. How much money did the stall take?

problem: How many tacos did the food truck at the beach serve at lunch, if it served 17 fish tacos, 6 bean tacos and 6 chicken tacos?
follow_up_questions: Each taco costs 3 dollars. What were the taco sales worth?

problem: Gemma's football team won 9 matches this season, drew 5 and lost 9. How many matches did the team play?

follow_up_questions: Each headband costs 3 dollars. How much money did the headbands bring in?
The wool cost 40 dollars. How much more did the stall earn than it spent on wool?

problem: How many kites did the beach shop sell over the summer, if it sold 18 in August but only 7 in June and 7 in July?
follow_up_questions: A kite sells for 3 dollars. How much did the kites bring in?
The shop paid 40 dollars for the kites. What was its profit?

problem: For the class party, Lena brought 4 packs of balloons and her friend Ravi brought 5. The classroom cupboard also had 7 packs from last year. How many packs do they have now?
follow_up_questions: Each pack holds 6 balloons. How many balloons is that?

problem: How many boxes of crayons are on the art table, if Mr. Silva put out 7 old boxes and two pupils added 4 and 5 new ones?
follow_up_questions: There are 6 crayons in every box. How many crayons are on the table?

problem: For the charity drive, Yuki and her cousin fill 13 bags with toys, 8 with old clothes and 8 with shoes. How many bags do they hand in?
follow_up_questions: Each bag earns their school 2 points. How many points do the bags earn?
The school already had 25 points. How many points does it have now?
A new set of library books costs 95 points. How many more points does the school need?

problem: What is the total number of litter bags the beach clean-up team filled, with 8 bags of plastic, 13 of cans and 8 of glass?
follow_up_questions: The council gives the team 2 tokens per bag. How many tokens do they get?
The team had saved 25 tokens before. How many tokens does it have now?
A trip to the aquarium costs 95 tokens. How many more tokens does the team need?

problem: For the science fair party, Teo baked 6 lemon cupcakes, 15 chocolate cupcakes and 6 strawberry cupcakes. How many cupcakes did he bake?
follow_up_questions: His team has 9 members, and the cupcakes are shared equally. How many does each member get?
Each member eats 2 at the party and takes the rest home. How many cupcakes go home in all?

problem: How many dumplings did Grandma Liu make for the new year, if she made 15 pork, 6 cabbage and 6 shrimp dumplings?
follow_up_questions: She shares them equally among the 9 people at the table. How many does each person get?
Each person eats 2 and wraps the rest to take home. How many dumplings are taken home altogether?

problem: At the library's summer fair, the librarians gave away 15 bookmarks, 6 posters and 12 pencils. A storyteller sat by the window. How many free gifts did they give away?
follow_up_questions: They had brought 50 gifts. How many are left?

problem: How many prizes did the clowns hand out at the circus, if they gave 12 whistles, 15 balloons and 6 masks? The lion slept through the whole show.
follow_up_questions: They had packed 50 prizes. How many prizes remain?

problem: At the beach, Zara collected 14 shells and her brother added 19 more to the bucket. At home they painted 25 of them. How many shells are still unpainted?
How many eggs have not been decorated yet, if Pietro boiled 14 eggs, his grandmother boiled 19, and the family has decorated 25 of them?
The garden club keeps 23 flowerpots on one shelf and 18 on another. They planted seeds in 29 of them. How many pots are still empty?
follow_up_questions: Each tray holds 4 pots. How many trays can be filled with the empty pots?

problem: How many batteries are left, if the camping shop had 23 in a basket and 18 on a shelf, and campers bought 29?
follow_up_questions: Every torch needs 4 batteries. How many torches can be filled with the batteries that are left?

problem: On the class trip to the farm, Ava took 35 photos of the cows and 28 of the sheep. Later she deleted 19 blurry ones. How many photos did she keep?
follow_up_questions: She prints the photos she kept for the class book, 4 to a page. How many pages does she fill?

problem: How many drawings are still on Kenta's tablet? He drew 35 dragons and 28 castles, then deleted 19 messy ones.
follow_up_questions: He fits 4 drawings on each page of a booklet. How many pages does the booklet have?

problem: Mrs. Andersen bought 2 boxes of stickers for her class. The first box holds 36 stickers and the second holds 36 too. So far the children have used 27 of them. How many stickers are left?
follow_up_questions: This week they use 15 more. How many are left now?
She wants the rest used up over 5 more weeks, the same number each week. How many stickers is that per week?

problem: How many crossword clues are still unsolved? Grandpa bought 2 crossword magazines; the first has 36 clues and the second also has 36. He has solved 27.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday he solves 15 more. How many are still unsolved?
He plans to finish the rest in 5 evenings, the same number each evening. How many clues is that per evening?

problem: The greengrocer receives 34 peaches from one orchard and 17 from another. Only 39 of them are firm enough to sell. How many peaches must she throw out?
follow_up_questions: She puts the good peaches into bags of 3. How many bags can she make?

problem: How many eggs were cracked, if the farm shop got 34 eggs from the brown hens and 17 from the white hens, and 39 arrived whole?
follow_up_questions: The whole eggs go into small boxes of 3. How many boxes are filled?

problem: At the toy fair, Sofia bought 16 toy cars and 19 toy animals. Of those, 12 came from the used-toy table. How many brand-new toys did she buy?
follow_up_questions: Each new toy cost 2 dollars. How much did Sofia pay for the new ones?

problem: How many new shirts did Mr. Diallo buy at the market, if he bought 16 plain shirts and 19 striped shirts and 12 of them were second-hand?
follow_up_questions: Each new shirt cost 2 dollars at the sale. What did the new shirts cost?

problem: The class camera held 37 photos and 45 videos from the school trip. To make space, the teacher deleted 58 files. How many files are still on the camera?
follow_up_questions: At sports day they add 16 new videos. How many files are on the camera now?
The teacher moves half of the files onto a laptop. How many files stay on the camera?

problem: How many songs are left on Ines's music player, if it had 37 pop songs and 45 rock songs and she deleted 58?
follow_up_questions: She then downloads 16 new songs. How many songs are on the player now?
She moves half of them to her computer. How many songs stay on the player?

problem: In a card game on a snowy evening, Mika won 18 points in the first round and 27 in the second. Then she drew a penalty card and lost 39 points. How many points does she have now?

Each one takes the daughter 5 minutes. How many minutes will she spend?

problem: How many quilt squares does Grandpa still need to sew, if he cut 38 blue squares and 15 red ones and has sewn 29?

The grandson needs 5 minutes for each square. How long will he spend sewing, in minutes?

problem: Amara picked 9 lemons and 15 oranges from the garden trees. She squeezed 15 of the fruits for juice. How many fruits were left?

problem: How many paper flowers were left after Diego folded 9 red and 15 yellow ones and pinned 15 of them to the classroom wall?
follow_up_questions: He gives the leftovers equally to his 3 sisters. How many does each sister get?
His sister Lupe already had 7 paper flowers. How many does Lupe have now?

problem: Kwame brought 24 cartons of eggs and 18 cartons of milk to sell at the village market. At the end of the day he loaded 9 cartons back onto his cart. How many cartons did he sell?

His market stall cost 15 dollars to rent. How much does he have after paying for it?
He buys 4 new baskets at 3 dollars each. How much money does he have now?

problem: How many plants did Mrs. Novak sell at the garden fair, if she brought 24 tomato plants and 18 pepper plants and took 9 home?
follow_up_questions: Each plant sold for 2 dollars. What did she earn?
The fair charged her 15 dollars for the table. How much does she have after paying?
She then buys 4 trowels at 3 dollars each. How much money is left?

problem: A toy shop gave the children's hospital 26 teddy bears and 19 toy rabbits. Nurse Kim carried 33 of them up to the wards. How many toys stayed in the storeroom?
follow_up_questions: The next day 8 more toys are donated. How many toys are in the storeroom now?

problem: How many sleeping bags were left at the scout hut, if a shop donated 26 green ones and 19 red ones and the leaders took 33 on the camping trip?
follow_up_questions: Later 8 more sleeping bags are donated. How many are at the hut now?

problem: For the class trip to the zoo, 21 girls and 24 boys signed up, but the big bus has only 36 seats. How many children won't fit on the bus?
follow_up_questions: The school hires a van with 15 seats for them. How many van seats will be empty?
The van company charges 4 dollars for every child in the van. What is the total charge?
The school pays for 3 of those children. How much do the other families pay in all?

problem: How many swimmers will have to wait, if 21 adults and 24 teenagers turn up for the swim session and the big pool has room for only 36 at once?
follow_up_questions: A small pool with 15 places opens for those waiting. How many places in it stay free?
